verdicts.reason: Both candidates share the same core flaws. The 'LIMITED SUMMER RELEASE' eyebrow is shrunk to unreadable micro-type and moved below the headline, which flips the reading order. The body copy is set almost as large as the headline, so the two compete for attention, and the text runs as a long, heavy column. In A, the dark header band is shrunk to a sliver and the SOLSTICE logo and wordmark become specks, so the brand all but disappears; the orange divider is also gone. B keeps a slightly taller header with a legible wordmark and keeps the orange divider, though it moves the divider above the headline. That makes B a little better on brand, but it is still not shippable.
